messages:
Riley: Quick office poll  which is more dramatic: a YAML tab slipping in, or semver dropping an unannounced major? :thinking_face:
Tess: YAML. Its stealthy. One indent and the app ghosts you. :ghost:
Omar: Semver does the theatrical exit though. Announces nothing, leaves a 500 on the table. :skull_and_crossbones:
build-bot: CI: :warning: Failed to parse deploy.yaml: unexpected indent at line 7
Riley: snippet:
```yaml
services:
  - name: api
    replicas: 3
     env:
       - name: MODE
         value: production
```
Tess: that extra space before 'env' is the villain. also looks like it was trying to be fancy.
Omar: New rule: whoever merges broken YAML has to bring doughnuts next standup. Very high ROI for linting. :doughnut:
Riley: I support. Also semver penalty: if you bump major without a heads-up, you buy lunch. Keeps midnight majors honest.
build-bot: :white_check_mark: Added yaml-lint to CI and a friendly reminder message for first-time offenders.
Tess: can we get a sticker that says "I run yaml-lint"? I'll wear it proudly.
Omar: I'll design one: picture of an angry dash and the caption "Mind your whitespace".
Riley: perfect. closing poll results: YAML wins 2-1 (by covert formatting).
